name: Roda de Ter (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white cogwheel towards the hoist and a narrow white stripe separating a yellow lower stripe half the depth of the blue.
history: The flag was approved on 18 May 1994 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 3 June 1994; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, blue, with a white cogwheel of diameter 1/2 centred at the hoist side, and a narrow white fess of 1/20 separating the lower yellow stripe, half the depth of the blue.

features.role: cogwheel of diameter 1/2, centred towards the hoist
